functionality.title: Native Resolution, Aspect Ratio and Pixel Density Conformance
functionality.brief: Verify the built-in panel reports its native resolution, 20:9 aspect ratio and ~409 ppi exactly as specified, with no hidden resolution or density override

functionality.title: Display Mode Enumeration and Peak Refresh-Rate Declaration
functionality.brief: Verify the display advertises a native-resolution 120 Hz mode plus a 60 Hz mode, and that every advertised mode is selectable by the platform

functionality.title: User Refresh-Rate Setting (Standard / High / Adaptive) Applied
functionality.brief: Verify each user-selectable refresh-rate setting results in the correct active display rate during interaction and at idle

functionality.title: App-Requested Frame Rate Honoured (setFrameRate / preferredDisplayModeId)
functionality.brief: Verify an app can request 60 Hz or the peak rate for its own window and the platform switches the display accordingly, then reverts when the app leaves

functionality.title: Manual Brightness Range and Monotonic Control
functionality.brief: Verify manual brightness spans the full range, never reaches a black screen at minimum, and increases monotonically; optionally confirm luminance with a meter

functionality.title: Adaptive Brightness Responds to Ambient Light
functionality.brief: Verify auto-brightness lowers the screen in darkness and raises it in bright light, driven by the ambient light sensor

functionality.title: Screen Timeout, User-Activity Reset and Wake Sources
functionality.brief: Verify the screen turns off after the configured timeout, user activity restarts the timer, and power/wake keys turn the screen back on

functionality.title: Auto-Rotate and Orientation Lock Behaviour
functionality.brief: Verify locked rotation holds the chosen orientation, each allowed rotation renders correctly, and auto-rotate follows a physical rotation

functionality.title: Display Cutout (Punch-Hole) Reporting and Safe-Area Layout
functionality.brief: Verify the punch-hole cutout is reported with correct bounds and that each layoutInDisplayCutoutMode keeps content out of, or intentionally inside, the cutout area

functionality.title: HDR Capability Declaration and HDR10 Playback Path
functionality.brief: Verify declared HDR types are consistent between platform and app APIs and that an HDR10 clip is decoded and composed with an HDR dataspace

functionality.title: Wide Colour Gamut and System Colour Mode Selection
functionality.brief: Verify wide-gamut capability is reported consistently and each system colour mode offered to the user is applied by SurfaceFlinger

functionality.title: Night Light (Blue-Light Filter) Activation, Intensity and Schedule
functionality.brief: Verify Night Light turns on/off, intensity (colour temperature) changes take effect, and a custom schedule activates and deactivates it automatically

functionality.title: System-Wide Dark Theme Application
functionality.brief: Verify dark theme switches system UI and Settings to dark rendering and back, measured from framebuffer luminance

functionality.title: Font Size and Display Size Scaling Without Truncation
functionality.brief: Verify system UI and Settings remain usable at larger font and display-size settings: configuration applied, no crash, no off-screen or newly ellipsized primary text

functionality.title: Accessibility Colour Inversion and Colour Correction
functionality.brief: Verify colour inversion and each daltonizer mode apply a display colour transform and remove it cleanly

functionality.title: Always-On Display Entry, Content and Exit
functionality.brief: Verify Always-On Display enters a low-power doze display state when the screen is turned off and exits on wake

functionality.title: Touchscreen Multi-Touch Capability and Feature Declaration
functionality.brief: Verify the touchscreen declares multi-touch features consistent with the controller, covers the full panel, and tracks at least 5 (target 10) simultaneous contacts

functionality.title: Touch Accuracy, Linearity and Edge Response
functionality.brief: Verify tap position error, line linearity and edge/corner registration meet accuracy targets across the panel

functionality.title: Screenshot and Screen-Recording Output Fidelity
functionality.brief: Verify shell and user-initiated screenshots and screen recordings match display geometry and contain valid media

functionality.title: Full-Screen Test Patterns: Dead/Stuck Pixels, Banding and Uniformity
functionality.brief: Verify the rendering path reproduces full-screen test patterns exactly and the panel shows no dead/stuck pixels, visible banding or gross non-uniformity

performance.title: Refresh-Rate Conformance at Peak Mode
performance.brief: Measured frame delivery rate at 120 Hz under continuous animation

performance.title: Scroll Frame Pacing and Jank at Peak Refresh
performance.brief: Fling scrolling in Settings at 120 Hz measured with gfxinfo

performance.title: Video Playback Frame Pacing and Cadence
performance.brief: 23.976 / 30 / 60 fps content presented without drops or judder

performance.title: Adaptive Refresh Idle Downshift Time
performance.brief: Time from last touch until the display leaves peak refresh

performance.title: Touch-Triggered Refresh Upshift Latency
performance.brief: Time from touch-down to first frame at peak rate after idle

performance.title: Display Wake Latency (Power Key to Screen On)
performance.brief: Power-key wake to display ON, shallow and deep idle

performance.title: Display Sleep Latency (Power Key to Panel Off)
performance.brief: Power-key sleep to display OFF

performance.title: Screen Rotation Latency
performance.brief: Portrait <-> landscape rotation completion time with Settings foreground

performance.title: Manual Brightness Change Settle Time
performance.brief: Brightness setting change to applied backlight level

performance.title: Auto-Brightness Convergence After Ambient Light Step
performance.brief: Brighten and darken convergence time; lux accuracy

performance.title: Peak and Sustained Luminance (HBM / Outdoor Mode)
performance.brief: White-window luminance at 10% and 100% APL, sustained 5 min

performance.title: Minimum Luminance for Low-Light Comfort
performance.brief: Full-white luminance at minimum manual brightness

performance.title: Colour Accuracy (CIEDE2000) in Natural / sRGB Mode
performance.brief: Average and maximum ΔE2000 over ColorChecker, primaries and grayscale

performance.title: Gamma (EOTF) Tracking and White-Point CCT
performance.brief: Grayscale gamma and white point in natural mode

performance.title: PWM Flicker at Low and Mid Brightness (IEEE 1789)
performance.brief: Flicker frequency and modulation depth at 10/25/50/100% brightness

performance.title: Touch-to-Display (Touch-to-Photon) Latency
performance.brief: Physical tap and drag to visible response

performance.title: Touch Report (Sampling) Rate
performance.brief: Touch controller report rate during continuous finger motion

performance.title: HWC Overlay Composition Efficiency During Full-Screen Video
performance.brief: Share of frames needing GPU (client) composition

performance.title: Display Power Draw vs Refresh Rate and Content
performance.brief: Device power for static black/white at 60/120 Hz

performance.title: SurfaceFlinger CPU Cost at Peak Refresh
performance.brief: SurfaceFlinger CPU during 120 Hz animation vs 60 Hz

reliability.brief: 1000 power-key off/on cycles with state and content checks

reliability.title: Refresh-Rate Mode Switching Endurance
reliability.brief: 1000 alternating 60 Hz / peak switches with verification

reliability.title: Screen Rotation Endurance

reliability.title: Brightness Sweep Endurance
reliability.brief: 500 full-range brightness sweeps with read-back

reliability.title: Doze / Always-On Display Enter-Exit Endurance
reliability.brief: 500 AOD enter/exit cycles

reliability.title: Static-Content Image Retention (Burn-In) Check
reliability.brief: 60 min high-contrast static UI then retention inspection

reliability.title: Continuous Peak-Refresh Animation Stability

reliability.title: High-Brightness Thermal Endurance
reliability.brief: 30 min max brightness + animation; derating and skin temperature

reliability.title: Dark / Light Theme Toggle Endurance
reliability.brief: 500 theme toggles with a foreground app

reliability.title: Night Light Toggle Endurance
reliability.brief: 500 Night Light on/off cycles

reliability.title: Display Size and Font Scale Change Endurance
reliability.brief: 200 density + font-scale changes with app relaunch

reliability.title: Secondary (Overlay) Display Hot-Plug Endurance
reliability.brief: 200 simulated display add/remove cycles with app placement

reliability.title: Screen Recording Start/Stop Endurance
reliability.brief: 200 screenrecord sessions with file validation

reliability.title: Screenshot Capture Endurance
reliability.brief: 500 screencap captures with PNG validation and SurfaceFlinger memory

reliability.title: Compositor and SystemUI Memory Stability Over Window Transitions
reliability.brief: 500 app open/close transitions

reliability.title: Touch Responsiveness After Sleep/Wake Cycles
reliability.brief: 500 sleep/wake cycles; touch controller and event delivery verified

reliability.title: Ambient Light Sensor and Auto-Brightness Continuity
reliability.brief: 60 min with periodic light changes; no sensor stall

reliability.title: Battery-Saver Display Policy Transitions
reliability.brief: 200 battery-saver on/off cycles; display policies applied and restored

reliability.title: Long Scrolling Endurance - Jank Drift
reliability.brief: 1000 flings; jank per 100-fling window must not degrade

reliability.title: Display Subsystem Crash / ANR / Tombstone Monitoring During Mixed Endurance
reliability.brief: 60 min randomized mix of display operations
